All earlier known/unknown source/access/transfer holds persist. No new chemical experiment, producer execution or source recovery is authorized.
contract.provides: ROOT solves one restrictive rectangular-pulse exactly-one-addition model and quantifies selective-hazard requirements. Uniformly scaling both hazards preserves optimized fidelity, while destruction of a thiol arm and clearance of its occupied DNA duplex remain separate stocks. A distinct track-based Wittig predecessor supplies limited physical bond-to-progression precedent; no producer ODE is refuted and no actual twenty-step autonomous chemical machine is supplied. Introduced constant first-addition hazard a and subsequent unwanted-addition hazard u during a single fixed rectangular pulse. Stages are independent and identical only for stated twenty-stage products. No retries, active rejection, geometry/sequence distribution or sidegroup authentication is included.
